# ThinkwithClaude

> ThinkwithClaude is the site of Shantanu Anand, an AI trainer and consultant based in Bengaluru, India. He runs hands-on AI training (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Microsoft Copilot) for professionals, teams and founders, online or in person anywhere in India.

## Key pages
- [Home: AI training for professionals and teams](https://www.thinkwithclaude.com/): sessions, results and how to book
- [AI Q&A](https://www.thinkwithclaude.com/ai-questions/): the most-discussed AI questions each day, answered in plain English
- [Articles](https://www.thinkwithclaude.com/blog/): practical guides on using AI at work
- [FDE for Coders](https://www.thinkwithclaude.com/fde-essentials/): a series on Forward Deployed Engineering
